packages.label: Glance
packages.reason: Puts news, games and ads on the lock screen. The lock screen works the same without it.

packages.label: Glance (phone-maker edition)
packages.reason: A brand-specific build of Glance, the lock-screen news and ads feed.

packages.label: Meta App Manager
packages.reason: Meta's preinstalled updater. Facebook and Instagram from the Play Store update without it.

packages.label: Meta Services
packages.reason: Meta background service that ships with the phone, not with any app you installed.

packages.label: Meta App Installer
packages.reason: A placeholder that exists to get Meta apps installed. It does nothing else.

packages.label: Netflix partner activation
packages.reason: Ties a preinstalled Netflix to the phone maker's deal. Netflix itself keeps working.

packages.label: Gemini
packages.reason: Google's Gemini app. Holding the power or home button stops opening it.
